text: tempest_run() executes five steps: perspectives, research, outline, write, polish. Key features: Persistent staged runs – pass output_dir save run artifacts completed stage; pass resume = TRUE load saved artifacts skip completed stages. ToC-enriched perspective discovery – seed URLs fetched table--contents headings extracted give coordinator richer context generating expert perspectives. Query decomposition – expert research question decomposed 2-3 targeted search queries retrieval. Semantic fact retrieval – ragnar configured, section writing uses semantic similarity select relevant facts (falls back keyword matching otherwise). Two-step outline – draft outline generated LLM’s parametric knowledge, refined research findings. Lead section – Wikipedia-style lead (2-3 paragraphs) generated prepended article. Parallel section writing – pass parallel_writing = TRUE write report sections concurrently mirai, assemble already-grounded sections evidence deterministic outline order. Governed dsprrr programs – every structured stage resolves exact addressable program TempestProgramSet, including verified dsprrr artifact ID, stage contract, evaluator identity.
